Tail offsets equal game-test shifted by -22400 (chatId 42008 -> 19608, happyHour 42020 -> 19620, clan 42040 -> 19640, end 42048 -> 19648). No allocation found, so this is inferred from the tail and the constructor
members: ActiveClanData::ActiveClanData: loop of 250 OnlineClanMember at this+0, stride 56
ClanDataNotification_HappyHour: *(this+19640) passed to OnlineClan_GetMemberRole and read at +8 for the clan id
changed_members: Replay offsets 19600 / 19604 inferred from the tail shift (game-test 42000 / 42004); not directly accessed
